crossRefs.note: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but…
Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
“ ‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness…
You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth:
But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his…
If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the…
It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten…
“Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
translations.bsb: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
translations.kjv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
translations.asv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: and sittest thou to judge me according to the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
